root_contract: For every smooth projective complex variety X and codimension p, every rational Hodge class of type (p,p) in H^{2p}(X,Q) is in the Q-span of codimension-p algebraic cycle classes.
question: Once an exact finite signed rational witness is realized by flat proper relative cycle components over a connected smooth reduced Hodge-branch locus, is preservation of the prescribed rational cohomology class an additional independent obligation, or is it forced by cycle-class transport?
scope: smooth projective complex family f:X->T over a connected smooth analytic/algebraic locus T contained in one reduced Hodge branch
fixed rational flat section alpha of R^{2p}f_*Q
fixed denominator N and integer coefficients n_i
closed subschemes Z_i subset X flat and proper over T of relative codimension p
class identity at one base point t0
no claim about constructing Z_i, formal-to-neighborhood descent, singular branch points, monodromy/component switching outside T, or root initial algebraicity

solved_or_near_solved_analogues: codimension-one Picard/Lefschetz-(1,1), where one line-bundle class gives exact cohomological identity
Kloosterman complete-intersection variational-Hodge setting, where an explicit witness family is constructed over the deformation base

disanalogies: the present atom starts only after a flat relative witness exists and therefore does not construct that witness
higher-codimension rational signed cycles need fixed denominator/coefficient bookkeeping and cannot be replaced by Picard data
class transport on a smooth connected locus does not by itself cross singular degeneration or monodromy/component switching
formal effectivity over a completed local ring is not the same as a flat relative family over an actual branch neighborhood
precommitted_falsifier: If a flat proper relative cycle family of fixed codimension can have a fibre cycle class that is not the parallel transport of its class at t0, the proposed conditional closure fails. Independently, a nonflat family with vertical components is a hostile control showing flatness cannot be dropped.
